# WASL | وصل

> WASL helps local businesses in Jordan build practical digital experiences, from websites and landing pages to QR/NFC touchpoints and Google Business Profile solutions.

WASL (وصل) is a digital agency based in Amman, Jordan. We build practical, fast, and purpose-driven digital touchpoints that bring local businesses closer to their customers without bloated templates or unnecessary complexity.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://wasljo.com/): Overview of WASL, our approach to connecting local businesses with customers, and featured work.
- [Services](https://wasljo.com/services): Practical digital services including Google Presence, custom websites, smart QR/NFC touchpoints, and custom digital experiences.
- [Work](https://wasljo.com/work): Showcase of concept projects and digital touchpoint implementations for local businesses.
- [About](https://wasljo.com/about): Our philosophy, mission, and background on helping local businesses in Jordan thrive digitally.
- [Contact](https://wasljo.com/contact): Direct contact channels to connect with the WASL team in Amman, Jordan.

## Work Concepts

- [Café Concept (NARA)](https://wasljo.com/demos/cafe): Specialty coffee and breakfast concept featuring a digital menu, story, atmosphere showcase, and smart touchpoint integration.
- [Restaurant Concept (DAR)](https://wasljo.com/demos/restaurant): Contemporary Levantine dining concept featuring a culinary showcase, digital menu, wine list, and reservation flow.
- [Barbershop Concept (LINEA)](https://wasljo.com/demos/barbershop): Modern grooming studio concept featuring service menus, team profiles, and direct appointment booking.
